scope: Auditor clock arithmetic correction; not physical qualification
cause: Repeated native2ms additions differ from step_index*dt by >1ns at361.926s. Auditor used the latter while simulator used the former.
fix: Derive expected epochs by repeated addition independently of archived timestamps; retain1ns tolerance and reject nonfinite epochs.
validation: 43 tests passed, including200000 timesteps and five timestamp fields corrupted with +/-one step,2ns,NaN or infinity.
